svg.text: IN AID OF ST. PETER'S CHURCH RESTORATION FUND

g.data-flaw: Minor: the venue lines are set narrower and start at the original's left edge, so they are no longer centred, and the rule between the attraction columns is lost.
g.data-outlook: Fixable: the builder should recognise centred lines and centre the reset text, and keep thin rules out of the blanking.
